The current price of $273.67 is below the SMA200 ($278.02) by -1.57% and below the EMA50 ($281.58) by -2.81%, positioning it near short-term resistance. The price is at 58.7% of its 52-week range, down 10.7% from the high of $305.18 and up 19.6% from the low of $228.90. Weekly RSI is 43.7 and weekly MACD histogram is -3.4639, both indicating a weak trend. Overall, a lack of clear indicator alignment and low volume warrants a wait-and-see approach for directional decisions.
